WITH equipment_data AS (
    SELECT 
        equipmentcode,
        safetyindex,
        reliabilityindex,
        performanceindex,
        environmentalimpactindex,
        ROUND(CAST((performanceindex + reliabilityindex) / 2.0 * (1 - environmentalimpactindex / 10.0) AS numeric), 4) AS EER
    FROM equipment
)
SELECT 
    equipmentcode,
    EER,
    ROUND(CAST(safetyindex * EER * 0.8 AS numeric), 4) AS OSPI
FROM equipment_data
ORDER BY OSPI DESC
LIMIT 20;
